summary: Official Uttar Pradesh BhuNaksha and Ambedkar Nagar land-record service routes establish a local/state cadastral viewer. The current hierarchy exposes Tanda tehsil and the native village entry टांडा खास, but that entry is marked hasData=false; bounded extent and plot probes produced no usable parcel identity or geometry. No GeoJSON sample is retained and runtime remains held.
queryOutcomes: Separate English and Hindi discovery queries are recorded in city-10251-tanda.json, with actual first-party result URLs.
requestOutcomes: The current official viewer HTML/JavaScript was fetched anonymously; district, tehsil and village selection routes returned the Tanda hierarchy; a bounded extent probe returned zero extent; plot-number and exact-point probes returned empty JSON; alternate extent probes returned HTTP 500 with upstream 403 details. No login, credentials, private token, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, unsafe lookup or TLS exception was used.
